item.title: Press release: UnionPay enables 25 international wallets to support Weixin Pay QR code in China’s mainland
item.description: 28th January 2026 – When Thai tourist Naree visited Shanghai, she paid easily for coffee at a neighbourhood café by scanning a Weixin Pay QR code using the same K PLUS mobile wallet as she used at home, because her mobile wallet was linked to her Thai UnionPay card. The post Press release: UnionPay enables 25 international wallets to support Weixin Pay QR code in China’s mainland first appeared on Treasury Today.

item.title: Press release: DHL Group adds new sustainability milestones in Asia Pacific across skies and streets
item.description: 2nd February 2026 – DHL Group has marked significant milestones in its sustainability journey across Asia Pacific by reinforcing its commitment to decarbonization and readiness to meet the region's growing demand for emissions-reduced logistics solutions. The post Press release: DHL Group adds new sustainability milestones in Asia Pacific across skies and streets first appeared on Treasury Today.

item.title: Press release: Visa study reveals growing adoption of real-time payments in South-East Asia, underscoring need for stronger security and trust
item.description: 2nd February 2026 – Real-time payments (RTPs) are becoming an integral part of everyday transactions across Southeast Asia, according to a regional study written in partnership with the Global Finance & Technology Network (GFTN), Nextrade Group, and the Visa Economic Empowerment Institute (VEEI). The post Press release: Visa study reveals growing adoption of real-time payments in South-East Asia, underscoring need for stronger security and trust first appeared on Treasury Today.

item.title: Press release: State Street, in collaboration with ADIO, to create 300+ new jobs with launch of new Al Ain operations hub
item.description: 27th January 2026 – State Street Corporation (NYSE: STT), one of the world’s leading providers of financial services to institutional investors, has signed a support agreement with the Abu Dhabi Investment Office (ADIO) to establish a new operating center in the Al Ain region, Abu Dhabi. The post Press release: State Street, in collaboration with ADIO, to create 300+ new jobs with launch of new Al Ain operations hub first appeared on Treasury Today.

item.title: Press release: Bottomline recognised by IDC a leader in AI-enabled midmarket treasury and risk management
item.description: 28th January 2026 – Bottomline, a global provider of business payments and cash management, today announced its position as a Leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide AI-Enabled Midmarket Treasury and Risk Management Applications 2025-2026 Vendor Assessment. The post Press release: Bottomline recognised by IDC a leader in AI-enabled midmarket treasury and risk management first appeared on Treasury Today.

item.title: Press release: Corporates enter the year with balance-sheet strength and remain selective on investment
item.description: 3rd February 2026 – Standard Chartered today published its Capital Structure & Rating Advisory (CSRA) Annual Insights 2026 – “Resilient Growth, Selective Investment”, highlighting a shift by global corporates towards more targeted and disciplined capital allocation even as the economic growth outlook remains resilient. The post Press release: Corporates enter the year with balance-sheet strength and remain selective on investment first appeared on Treasury Today.

item.title: Press release: “There is no shortage of good ideas” report sets out how UKRI can set more spin-outs up for success
item.description: 3rd February 2026 – UKRI Research England has today published an independent report by Tony Hickson, Chief Business Officer at Cancer Research UK, following his deep dive review of relationships between universities and investors. The post Press release: “There is no shortage of good ideas” report sets out how UKRI can set more spin-outs up for success first appeared on Treasury Today.

item.title: Press release: Deutsche Börse Group’s 360T partners with Bitpanda to expand digital asset capabilities
item.description: 3rd February 2026 – 360T, part of Deutsche Börse Group, and Bitpanda announced today a partnership focused on expanding access to crypto trading, with plans for further expansion across the digital assets space.
